sections.title: Why ASEAN buyers source RFID from Proud Tek
bullets: Proximity advantage — Shenzhen to Bangkok is 3 hours by air; sea freight reaches Southeast Asian ports in 5-8 days, cutting lead times by 60% versus European or US manufacturers.
Price competitiveness — factory-direct pricing with no trading company markup makes MOQ 500-piece orders viable even for small hotel chains and event organizers.

Hotel key card demand — rapid hospitality growth across Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, and Indonesia drives demand for MIFARE Classic, Plus, and DESFire cards compatible with local lock installations.
Event and tourism — music festivals, trade shows, and theme parks across ASEAN increasingly adopt RFID wristbands for cashless payment and access control.

faq.question: How fast can you deliver to Southeast Asia?
faq.answer: Express shipping (DHL/FedEx) takes 3-5 working days from Shenzhen. Sea freight reaches major ASEAN ports in 5-8 days. We also maintain stock of common blank cards for faster dispatch.

faq.question: Do you support small orders for boutique hotels?
faq.answer: Yes. Our MOQ is 500 pieces for custom-printed hotel key cards, which is suitable for small properties. For blank cards, even smaller quantities are available from stock.

faq.question: Can you provide Trade Assurance?
faq.answer: Yes. For new buyers, we offer Alibaba Trade Assurance for payment protection. We also accept T/T, PayPal, and Western Union.
